title: already known
summary: The exact same transaction hash is already in the mempool. The node deduplicated your resubmit.
likelyCauses: Client retry without changing any field.
nextSteps: Treat as a non-error — just wait for inclusion.
If stuck, replace with a higher fee using the same nonce.

title: execution reverted
summary: The EVM executed the REVERT opcode. Revert data, if present, contains the reason as Error(string), Panic(uint256), or a custom error.
likelyCauses: An arithmetic overflow caused a Panic.
An access-control check failed (Ownable, AccessControl, paused).
nextSteps: Look for `:` in the message — many providers append the revert string after `execution reverted:`.
If raw bytes are available, decode them.
Cross-check approval / allowance / balance / pause state.
